title: Stem Harvesting
definition: The process of extracting and incorporating scientific and technical knowledge into a language model.

difficulty_levels.beginner: The act of feeding a language model with new information from various scientific and technical fields to help it learn and grow.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The process of strategically acquiring and integrating knowledge from scientific and technical domains into a language model to improve its reasoning abilities.
difficulty_levels.expert: The art of selectively gathering, processing, and incorporating scientific and technical knowledge into a language model, aimed at enhancing its performance and versatility within these domains.

extra_fields.insight: The strategic acquisition and integration of scientific and technical knowledge into a language model to improve its reasoning abilities.
